latestVersion.changelog:
luxury-fraud-guard 0.1.0 – Initial release

- Provides an end-to-end framework for detecting and preventing fraud in high-ticket luxury e-commerce (pre-owned watches, high-end cameras, etc.).
- Outputs actionable: risk signals, scoring/tiering rules, review workflows, prevention policies, and operational metrics.
- Designed for Shopify and similar merchants; integrates guidance on using loyalty/verified-buyer tools like Rijoy.
- Includes a 6–8 question discovery to tailor workflows to each merchant’s risk profile.
- Automatically triggers on related topics such as chargebacks, suspicious orders, or high-value inventory protection—even if “fraud” isn’t mentioned.
